main_body: A 4x3-tile farm ground patch: a golden wheat-field band on top, a grass strip below it, then tilled soil rows with green sprouts. It is flat ground, not a standing object.
top_band: none. The ground is a flat surface with no standing volume, and no top band or front face applies.
evidence: This is terrain, so the 3/4 contract for standing objects does not apply. Wheat (rows 0-15), grass (16-21), and furrowed soil with sprout tufts (22-47) all read as ground surface. No isometric side faces and no object elevation are drawn.

style.evidence: Each material has several lightness steps: wheat in cream, yellow, olive and brown; grass in about four to five greens; soil in about four to five browns with lighter clods. Dark edges are tinted dark brown or dark green rather than neutral black. Wheat speckle, grass tufts, furrow grain and sprouts give no large flat fills. Each tile carries many colours, at least as many as the grass and paving references.
